description: This file defines the Faiss_VectorStores class implementing a node for Faiss vector store operations, including upsert and initialization, with methods for similarity search and integration with a larger system.

classes.name: Faiss_VectorStores
classes.description: A class implementing a Faiss vector store node with methods for upserting documents and initializing the store.

methods.name: vectorStoreMethods
methods.description: Contains the upsert method to add documents to the Faiss store.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Faiss vector store, loads data, and returns either a retriever or the vector store based on configuration.
